artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q\geq 1$. Let $\Gamma_q$ denote the (topological) groupoid of germs of local $C^\infty$-diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb{R}^q$, and let $G_q\subset\Gamma_q$ be the subgroupoid consisting of germs fixing the origin $0\in\mathbb{R}^q$. Let $B\Gamma_q$ and $BG_q$ denote their classifying spaces (Haefliger classifying spaces). Taking the derivative at $0$ gives a map $BG_q\to BGL_q(\mathbb{R})$ which classifies the normal bundle of the universal $G_q$-structure; let $B\bar G_q$ be the homotopy fibre of this map. Similarly let $B\bar\Gamma_q$ be the homotopy fibre of $B\Gamma_q\to BGL_q(\mathbb{R})$. The inclusion $G_q\hookrightarrow\Gamma_q$ induces a map $B\bar G_q\to B\bar\Gamma_q$.

Question: Is the map $B\bar G_q\to B\bar\Gamma_q$ null-homotopic? Equivalently, is $B\bar G_q$ homotopically trivial inside $B\bar\Gamma_q$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question, originally posed by Tsuboi (1984) under the heading "foliations with only one leaf," concerns the homotopy triviality of the classifying space of the germ-stabilizer subgroupoid inside the framed Haefliger classifying space. Web searches surface Tsuboi's and Hurder's surveys on classifying spaces for foliations but reveal no resolution; the problem continues to be cited as an open question in recent foliation-theory problem lists.

status_evidence.title: Foliation Geometry/Topology Problem Set — Steven Hurder
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses open questions on Haefliger classifying spaces $B\Gamma_q$ and the relationship with $BG_q$ and normal bundle data, citing Tsuboi.
status_evidence.claim: The status of homotopy-theoretic questions about $B\bar G_q\to B\bar\Gamma_q$ is treated as an open problem in foliation classifying-space theory.

status_evidence.title: Classifying foliations — Steven Hurder
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of open problems on $B\Gamma_q$ and homotopy properties of Haefliger structures, referencing Tsuboi's questions.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution to Tsuboi's 'foliations with only one leaf' question is reported.
